description: Per-minute impressions and currency-converted spend for CPM-strategy PLA campaigns on a single day, grouped by marketing_campaign_group_id and by minute-of-day (hour 0-23 + minute 0-59), timezone-aware in the marketplace's local timezone. Scope with start_date = end_date to the target day and filter marketing_campaign_group_id to the CPM campaign groups of interest. The Python layer sums total impressions/spend and derives per-minute pacing curves.

marketing_campaign_group_id.description: The marketing campaign group the impressions/spend are attributed to (from campaign_tagging_data). Filter this to the CPM-strategy campaign groups you want to inspect. SAFE_CAST to STRING for stable id matching.

hour.description: Hour-of-day (0-23) in the marketplace's local timezone that the impression/spend occurred, derived from response_timestamp_utc.

minute.description: Minute-of-hour (0-59) in the marketplace's local timezone; combine with hour for per-minute granularity.

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(i.response_timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN i.unique_impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
impressions.description: Unique impressions served in this minute for this campaign group.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(i.response_timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN COALESCE(i.bid, 0) * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Spend in this minute (bid), converted from USD to the marketplace currency via static_currency_conversion.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_product_ads_response_to_impressions_mapping` AS i INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.campaign_tagging_data` AS t ON i.campaign_id = t.campaign_id JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON i.marketplace_client_id = mc.marketplace_client_id LEFT JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.static_currency_conversion` AS scc ON scc.from_currency = 'USD' AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND DATE(TIMESTAMP(i.response_timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
